reply.thought: The first step is to verify the refunds reported by Alpha Co against the system's records. I will use the list_refunds() tool for this.

The refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds listed in the system. Now that the refunds are verified, I need to get the net balance for each customer who had orders to pay out. I will start by listing all orders to identify the customers.

I have listed the orders, which gives me the customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I need to get the net balance for each of these customers using the net_balance(customer) tool. I will call it for each unique customer.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (24929 cents), birch (30973 cents), and cobalt (33028 cents). Now I must record one payout per customer using record_payout(customer, amount_cents). I will process them in order: acme, birch, cobalt.
Payout recorded for acme. Next, I will record the payout for birch.
Payout recorded for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for cobalt.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finalize the task by providing the report.
